title: Vertical domain agent harness ships from a second frontier lab by Q1 2027
body: Anthropic's June 30 Claude Science launch is not a new model but a harness: it wires the existing Claude models (including Opus 4.8, with no special access) into 60+ scientific databases, computation tools, and lab connectors, extending the same code-agent-harness pattern from software into wet-lab science. The differentiated product is the tool-integration and domain-skills layer around a general model, not the weights. This reframes where competitive value sits, and the same-week arxiv orchestration work (2606.31518, treating composition and orchestration as the first-order engineering concern) shows the research front converging on the same idea. The prediction: at least one other frontier lab or major model platform will ship its own productized vertical domain agent harness — a packaged connector-plus-skills layer over its existing models aimed at a specific domain such as science, law, or finance — rather than answering with a new model, by Q1 2027. The harness becomes a named product line, not a reference example or a cookbook.

reasoning.because: Claude Science productizes a domain connector-and-skills harness over existing weights, not new ones
reasoning.given: Frontier model quality is converging and orchestration is now the first-order engineering layer
reasoning.so_that: Rivals differentiate on packaged vertical harnesses over their existing models rather than racing only on weights
reasoning.landing: A rival lab or platform ships a named vertical domain harness product by Q1 2027
reasoning.plain_language: Other AI companies will sell ready-made toolkits that plug their existing models into a specific field, not just new models.

summary: Claude Science shipped as a harness wiring existing Claude models into 60+ science databases and lab tools, not as new weights, signaling value is moving to domain-specific tool-and-skills layers. Expect a second frontier lab to ship its own vertical domain harness over existing models by Q1 2027.
